info.name: CampusCore API
info.description:
Complete CampusCore backend API collection (auto-generated from the Spring Boot controllers).

Base path is /api on port 8300. Select the 'CampusCore (Local)' environment before running.

1. Run Auth > Login (or Register) first — it stores the JWT, userId and role into the environment automatically.
2. Fill in the resource ID variables (programId, courseId, studentId, examId, etc.) as you create records.
3. Bearer auth is applied at the collection level using {{accessToken}}; individual auth endpoints override it to no-auth.
